Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE original adult MALE cultivator, full body, for a Chinese fantasy game's combat.
Image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only (a female colored leather shadow puppet). Match its flat dyed leather, muted colors, thin dark cut-edge line, warm ivory skin, carved cloud motifs and restrained grain. Do NOT copy the female body, hairstyle or robe.
The new man must look like a graceful strong adult: broader shoulders than the female, straight masculine torso, slightly angular broad jaw, short natural neck entering the cross collar, approximately seven heads tall. No cartoon/chibi head, no tiny pinched torso, no stretched limbs. Face is a BLANK warm ivory leather plane: no eyes, brows, nose lines, mouth, beard, facial marks. Slight three-quarter side view facing screen RIGHT.
Matte ink-black hair half up in a compact bun tied with a simple muted red cloth band, long rear hair down to the shoulder blades. No jeweled hairpin.
Wear a slate-blue and warm ivory cross-collar Chinese cultivator robe, muted blue-grey wide sleeves and long divided coat panels, a small cinnabar red waist sash. A few simple ivory carved cloud patterns on cuffs and lower hem, sparse rather than busy. Arms completely covered by sleeves, only compact hands exposed; five correct fingers on each hand. Small practical dark boots, normal short toes, no curled giant shoes. Knees have sufficient room under divided robe, adult stance, feet lightly separated.
Anatomy/placement on a tall 1024x1536 full canvas: bun around y60..160; face around y210..370; neck/collar around y375..440; shoulders around (455,455) and (680,455), waist sash around (585,650); hanging wrist heights approximately y835, fingertips end around y915, no long palm or fingers. Robe hem y1280..1370, shoe soles near y1490. Head-to-boot composition uses comfortable margins and includes whole figure. Arms held slightly away from torso so shapes read clearly, with forearms relaxed forward. Shoulder seams concealed by cloth, no mechanical holes.
This is a FLAT COLORED CHINESE SHADOW-THEATRE PUPPET: softly translucent dyed hide with internal warm light, sparse shallow cut engraving, big readable colored shapes. Simplified game art, not an ornate costume showcase or realistic cloth portrait. True transparent alpha outside the figure, no background/glow/shadow/floor, no rods, no visible rings/holes/bolts at crown, neck or shoulders, no text. Avoid all-black silhouette, photorealism, anime, plastic 3D sheen, overlong hands, giant boots, overlong neck, overlapping neck pieces.
